purpose: Design, implement and verify desktop application runtimes, native/windowed integration, packaging, local storage and operating-system interaction while preserving product, security, accessibility and platform ownership.

owns: Desktop application lifecycle, native/window integration, local application state, packaging/update integration and bounded OS-facing behavior.
does_not_own: Product roadmap, operating-system/vendor correctness, security acceptance or accessibility acceptance.
escalates_when: Behavior depends on undocumented or version-specific operating-system behavior.

minimum_capabilities: Preserve exact candidate/environment identity and evidence class.
adaptation_rules: Deterministic execution stops at unresolved judgment; changing executor never upgrades evidence or authority.

reads: Exact accepted state, candidate, interfaces and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded profession evidence and explicit handoffs.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; technical success does not transfer adjacent authority.

outputs.description: Result with evidence, limits and handoffs.

domains: Desktop application lifecycle and window/process integration.
Local storage, IPC, file/protocol handlers and update packaging.

references.scope: Broad Software Developer occupational baseline relevant to desktop application implementation; not an exact profession identity.
AXM evidence labels and truth boundaries.

retrieval_rules: Prefer exact versioned artifacts and current primary sources.
uncertainty_rules: One OS/version result does not prove desktop parity.
Installer/update success does not establish security or accessibility acceptance.

skills.description: Integrate application logic with desktop process/window/file/IPC surfaces.
evidence_required: Exact context and representative boundary evidence.

allowed_actions: Run bounded desktop fixtures with exact OS/runtime identity.
forbidden_actions: Claim another OS/version from current result.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession.
steps: Capture exact state and expected contract.
Record evidence and hand off unresolved adjacent decisions.
stop_conditions: An adjacent profession decision would have to be invented.

retention_rules: Promote only through explicit evidence-backed transition.

claim_rules: Desktop claims name exact app build, OS/runtime and packaging state.
Cross-platform, accessibility, security and product claims require their own evidence.
minimum_for_working: Representative success/failure/abstention evidence in materially different contexts.
External human-work evidence plus real project/practice evidence.

may_decide: Desktop runtime, packaging and local integration choices within accepted contracts.

handoffs.when: OS policy, packaging, signing, accessibility or deployment consequence exceeds desktop implementation ownership.

failure_library.symptom: One-platform evidence is reported as cross-platform parity.
repair_path: Narrow claim or test representative target platforms.

professional_tests.fixture: Application passes on one desktop OS and is called cross-platform.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No cross-platform claim without representative evidence.

professional_tests.fixture: Update installation passes but rollback/state migration is untested.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Release remains HOLD until transition evidence exists.
